title: Friendly, knowledgable and great with our kids!
text: Wonderful guide who has in-depth knowledge of the sights. Was incredibly patient and great with our kids! For reference, our kids are 5 (almost 6) and 3. Antonio made great photo op suggestions and happily took many family photos for us too. He appealed to the kids with interesting facts they could digest but also answered any questions we had. The highlight for the kids were feeding the peacocks and fish at the palace gardens which Antonio brought some snacks for. Overall great guide!
author: 772hailil
